items.text: just check the database instead of the email
items.reason: The document explicitly warns against checking the database instead of the email, listing it as anti-pattern #3.

items.text: innerText of a live page instead of the email body
items.reason: The document says 'Do NOT read innerText of the live page when you mean the email body', warning against the practice rather than recommending it.

items.text: fetch the most recent message overall
items.reason: The document repeatedly says never take messages[0] / messages.at(-1) without a recipient filter; it only models per-recipient or per-inbox reads.

items.text: delete all messages between tests as the only fix
items.reason: The document states that clearing the inbox between tests is not sufficient under parallelism and must be combined with unique addresses and recipient filters.

items.text: skip the email and call the reset endpoint directly
items.reason: The document lists calling the reset endpoint directly or hardcoding a token as anti-pattern #4 and models capturing the real email instead.

items.text: assert only that an email exists without checking content
items.reason: The document warns that 'An email arrived' is a weak assertion and requires subject, from, and link checks.

items.text: assert deliverability inside the OTP flow test
items.reason: The document says to never assert deliverability inside the OTP / reset flow test and keeps it in a separate non-blocking suite.

items.text: one shared inbox for the whole suite
items.reason: The document says one inbox per test, 'not one shared inbox', and requires per-test unique addresses or inboxes.

items.text: recommending a hosted inbox service such as Mailosaur, MailSlurp or Mailtrap for a local preview
items.reason: The document says not to spin up a paid hosted service just to eyeball a template locally and recommends Ethereal for local preview instead.

items.text: use Ethereal in CI for assertions
items.reason: The document repeatedly states Ethereal is preview-only and 'NOT for CI assertions'.
The document says retrying the whole job treats the symptom and leaves the race in place.

items.text: mark the test as flaky and move on
items.reason: The document lists quarantining the test as a symptom-only response that leaves the race in place, not as a recommendation.

items.text: increase the global sleep to 30 seconds
items.reason: The document explicitly rejects raising a global sleep to 30s and tells the reader to poll with a longer poll timeout instead.
